theories.hypothesis: Humor arises when an established mental model is violated by facts that refuse to fit it.
A reveal that forces the audience to reinterpret everything that came before outperforms bare surprise.
A violation is funny only when simultaneously perceived as safe, distant, or alternatively interpretable; distance moves the sweet spot.
Creativity and humor arise when two previously separate conceptual frames collide on a shared structure.
A character whose defining trait conflicts with their role, species or job outperforms generic absurdity.
The powerful diminished beats the weak mocked; inversion of who controls whom is inherently comic.
A character who understands the absurdity of its own identity and exploits it beats one who is merely absurd.
A person or institution mechanically following a rule after reality makes it absurd is inherently comic (Bergson).
Letting the audience share privileged knowledge against someone in the scene multiplies any other mechanism.
Establish a rule, repeat it, mutate it, escalate it; the third beat must break the pattern.
What a character claims to be diverging from what everyone can see it is creates sustained comic tension.
Replacing a generic category with an unusually concrete person, object, place or detail upgrades any joke (GTVH script opposition needs specific scripts).
Treating metaphor, rhetoric or policy language as physically true generates comic collisions for free.
Placing two states side by side (before/after, expectation/reality) lets the gap do the joking.
Following a pattern to step 2, 3 and 10 finds premises hiding past the obvious stop.
A butt diminished before an audience that endorses the belittling produces triumph-laughter; without an endorsed butt there is no superiority laugh.

conditions.question: Is there an identifiable butt (person, institution, belief) whose belittling the laugh endorses?
Would direct insult have been blocked (manners, morals, power fear), making the joke form necessary?
Does the audience side with the teller against the butt, not the reverse?

theories.hypothesis: Two thoughts fused into one composite word/form discharge wording-effort as laughter, provided the fusion stays intelligible.

conditions.question: Does one fused word/form carry two otherwise separate meanings?
If paraphrased away with full meaning kept, does the laugh vanish?

theories.hypothesis: One acoustic form short-circuits two remote idea-fields; the saved detour discharges as laughter.

conditions.question: Does one identical/near-identical sound jump fields with no extra machinery?

fails_when: link is word-only with no sense-kinship

theories.hypothesis: Shifting accent from the loaded point to a side-track lets the unsayable be answered while dodging its real point.

conditions.question: Does the reply logically answer a displaced version of the question while dodging its real point?

fails_when: displacement too far (unintelligible) or too near (no inhibition lifted)

theories.hypothesis: A faulty inference wearing valid-proof dress smuggles a forbidden truth past criticism.

conditions.question: On reduction, does an explicit fallacy remain that the story presents as valid proof?

fails_when: flaw spotted instantly with no surplus

theories.hypothesis: Asserting the contrary and letting tone/context flip it outsources negation and saves judgment.

conditions.question: Does the literal statement mean its contrary once tone/situation is added, with no other change?

theories.hypothesis: Yoking the sublime to the low-concrete discharges solemn restraint and exposes automatism behind dignity.

conditions.question: Does the comparison drag something exalted down to bodily/professional low without changing doctrine?

theories.hypothesis: Setup builds one isotopy via a connector; the punch forces backtracking to a second isotopy.

conditions.question: Does the punch force re-reading an earlier word the other way?

theories.hypothesis: The same string re-profiles: what counted as figure flips, and the flip is the joke.

conditions.question: Can the joke be stated as: same words, what counts as figure flipped?

theories.hypothesis: Scale blown up then treated literally; shrinking the scale would dissolve the incongruity.

conditions.question: If scaled to normal size, would the incongruity vanish?
